channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Texas widened its data-center stall and Indonesia printed a campus groundbreak while the public rental tape stayed flat. On 21 Sep Governor Abbott directed TCEQ to halt all data-center permits until ERCOT finishes its Large Load audit (TCEQ compliance update due 19 Oct). On 22 Sep BDx broke ground on CGK4 in Jatiluhur, West Java: 640 MW planned, 845 MVA from PLN, Building 1 targeting 120 MW IT with first contracted phase early 2027. Fluidstack said construction has begun on a $4B first phase in Cameron County planned for up to 1.5 GW (county worksite permit is site-work; building permits still ahead). Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson introduced a proposed 12-month data-center moratorium on 23 Sep (introduction only, not enacted). Silicon Tape re-read 24 Sep: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW; Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29 and DigitalOcean B300 spot $8.00 / MI350X spot $3.00 all confirm vs 23 Sep. CleanSpark $2.276B notes still open to 25 Sep (EFTS shows only the 18 Sep pricing 8-K). Three new Wire ids.
